title: Thunderbirds in Formation
content:
HQ Web Team

Nov 16, 2026

U.S. Air Force Thunderbirds fighter jets pass overhead during the agency’s MAX POWER expo and air show on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026, at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. NASA’s inaugural MAX POWER was an aerospace festival celebrating the past, present, and future of flight and space exploration in honor of America’s 250th anniversary.

Image credit: NASA/Brandon Hancock
